title: Trusting All SSL Certificates via badCertificateCallback
description: A custom `HttpClient` overrides `badCertificateCallback` to unconditionally return `true`, completely disabling X.509 certificate chain and hostname verification across all HTTPS requests.
attack_vector: An attacker uses mitmproxy or Burp Suite with a self-signed certificate to intercept TLS traffic; because `badCertificateCallback` returns `true`, the Flutter app blindly accepts the rogue certificate.
fix_rationale: Never return `true` unconditionally in `badCertificateCallback`. Validate certificates against the system trust store or enforce SPKI/certificate pinning for known backend hosts.
